Mini mPOS takes payments with the Adyen Terminal API and the Adyen Java API library. It can run on the payment terminal, or use a terminal on your network or over the internet (cloud). Tap to Pay uses the Adyen Payments app on a phone. Mini mPOS encrypts messages to a terminal or the Payments app with the shared key. Cloud requests use your API key for authentication.

Switching between LIVE, TEST, and simulator permanently deletes all local payment history and daily report data. Products and other settings stay. Adyen records are not deleted.
Unfinished payments exist. This does not cancel payments, authorizations, or links at Adyen. Local recovery and safe retry data will be lost.
%1$s · %2$s\nThis terminal does not yet have an encryption key. Generate and save a new key? Existing keys at Adyen are reused. Do not edit this terminal’s settings elsewhere during creation.

%1$s · %2$s\nRead Adyen settings first. If creation needs retrying, use the same saved key.
